items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Something similar to what Brooks Kerr had before he went completely blind.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played cards! But I'm telling you, going to that place, you would have trouble getting in that place without stumbling, you know. In other words, he wasn't... I don't think he was totally blind.
He had I think what they call peripheral vision. At a certain angle he'd be able to see. Something similar to what Brooks Kerr had before he went completely blind.
